blocks.text: 4 April 2023
Juror off sick
CONTENTS
Housekeeping
Tuesday, 4 April 2023
(Delay in proceedings)
(In the absence of the jury)
Housekeeping

Mr Johnson, Mr Myers, I don't know whether you have been given the information that a juror has rung in saying that they are not fit to attend. They left a message because it was before anyone was manning the telephone, and so contact is trying to be made to see what the nature of the problem is and whether -- how long it's likely to last. In other words, is it going to be more than just a day?
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: MR JOHNSON

blocks.text: So I think in relation to that, we'll just have to wait until we get more information, but as far as I can see, there is no prospect of us doing anything today, I'm afraid.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: No.
blocks.speaker: MR JOHNSON

blocks.text: Professor Arthurs is on the link, I can see him there, so he can hear what's being said.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: I think, rather than engaging in a round table discussion about what the potential difficulties are so far as he is concerned and so on, that can be done behind the scenes. It'll be much more efficient and much more appropriate.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: MR JOHNSON

blocks.text: So unless either of you have any comments you wish to make, that's it.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: No, my Lord, thank you.
blocks.speaker: MR MYERS

blocks.text: No, my Lord. Just so that Professor Arthurs hears, we'll ring him later this morning, if that's acceptable, and get some dates from him and work to accommodate his availability.
blocks.speaker: MR JOHNSON

blocks.text: Exactly, thank you.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: Mr Myers, thank you for the documents.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: We'll provide paper copies before the end of this term so your Lordship has those available.
blocks.speaker: MR MYERS

blocks.text: There's no need to provide a paper copy of the actual application because I will print that off myself, but I haven't had a chance yet to look at how big the volume of materials is. I'm not proposing to print that off.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: We'll provide a copy for that. Its size belies actually what it is that's referred to. There are discrete aspects of it referred to but it seemed appropriate that your Lordship had the material in any event, and my learned friends as well, so we have access to everything. By no means do we go to all of that which has been provided to the court.
blocks.speaker: MR MYERS

blocks.text: No, but thank you very much. I obviously now have the opportunity to consider that.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: We will leave the court open. I'm going to keep the jurors here for the time being until we have further information.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: Yes. So far as the day's business is concerned, plainly there's not going to be any evidence heard, but there is a pressing issue between us, which we may invite your Lordship to consider or at least consider part of it or principles relating to it. So could we ask that your Lordship is available?
blocks.speaker: MR JOHNSON

blocks.text: I will be, I'll be here all day. No doubt about it.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: Thank you very much.
blocks.speaker: MR JOHNSON

blocks.text: So would you kindly tell the jury that...
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: We may have some up-to-date information.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: (Pause)

Contact has now been established. Not feeling well, temperature, hopes to be fit for tomorrow, but will be contacted this afternoon to see how she is and a decision will therefore be made later this afternoon about tomorrow.
Yes.
blocks.speaker: MR JOHNSON

blocks.text: I can't do any better than that.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: No. Those symptoms are entirely in keeping with the way I felt last week and all of us have been feeling, so it won't be a surprise.
blocks.speaker: MR JOHNSON

blocks.text: There are quite a lot of viruses about at the moment, including, of course, COVID. But there are lots of other coronaviruses as well.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: There are. Take your pick.
blocks.speaker: MR JOHNSON

blocks.text: So could you tell the jury, please, that as they will know, one of their number is not well enough to attend today, so they will not be required today. They will be contacted by the jury officer later in the afternoon in the usual way about tomorrow.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: Thank you very much.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: As far as Ms Letby is concerned, she will obviously remain here.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: Yes, my Lord, we would be grateful for that.
blocks.speaker: MR MYERS

blocks.text: If there's going to be a hearing, she should be here in relation to the matter Mr Johnson's referred to.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: We can use some of the time to meet with her as well, which will be of assistance.
blocks.speaker: MR MYERS

blocks.text: You can confer with her. Thank you very much indeed.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: (The court adjourned until a time and date to be determined)
